in_sanskrit.name: धृतिमान
in_sanskrit.meaning: धृति (Dhriti) + मान (man) = One who holds Dhriti (Dharma)
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: धृति (Dhriti) is the goddess of moral values, justice, and consistency. A person named Dhritiman embodies these qualities and holds on to them firmly.

in_hindi.name: धृतिमान
in_hindi.meaning: धृति (Dhriti) + मान (man) = धर्ता (dharatā) + मान (man) = One who holds the earth or the moral values
in_hindi.long_meaning: धृति (Dhriti) is a Sanskrit word meaning 'moral values, justice, and consistency'. A person named Dhritiman embodies these qualities and holds on to them firmly, like the earth holds the universe.

in_tamil.name: திர்திமான
in_tamil.meaning: திர் (Thir) + திமான (timāṉ) = One who holds Dharma (Thirumagan)
in_tamil.long_meaning: திர் (Thir) is a Tamil word meaning 'Dharma'. A person named Dhritiman embodies these qualities and holds on to them firmly, like Thirumagan, the god of Dharma, holds the universe.

in_telugu.name: ధృటిమాన
in_telugu.meaning: ధృటి (dhṛti) + మాన (mān) = One who holds Dhriti (Dharma)
in_telugu.long_meaning: ధృటి (dhṛti) is a Sanskrit word meaning 'moral values, justice, and consistency'. A person named Dhritiman embodies these qualities and holds on to them firmly, like the earth holds the universe.

in_marathi.name: Dhritiman
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे One who holds or supports
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhritiman हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dhriti means support or hold. Man means mind or soul. Thus, Dhritiman is the one who holds or supports the mind or soul.

in_bengali.name: Dhritiman

vedic_reference.note: Dhritiman is derived from the Sanskrit word धृति (dhṛti), which is a feminine noun meaning 'moral values, justice, and consistency'. In Hindu mythology, Dhriti is personified as the goddess of moral values and is often depicted as the consort of Indra, the god of rain and thunder. A person named Dhritiman embodies these qualities and holds on to them firmly, like the goddess Dhriti holds the moral fabric of the universe.
